description: This is a shell script implementing test cases and setup for git history visualization, focusing on the concepts of 'TREESAME' commits and limiting commit history views. It includes functions for setting up git commits, creating branches, and performing merges, as well as assertions to verify correct log outputs against expected history paths.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Creates a git tag with the provided name.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Processes the output of 'git name-rev' to extract annotated revision names.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Executes a git log command with specified parameters and compares the output to expected value.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wraps 'check_outcome' to verify successful git log output with given parameters.
